t: Delivers clean curved cuts in wood. Features bi-metal with fully hardened, high-speed steel tooth strip and highly elastic high carbon steel body. Pointed tooth design for reduced tear-out and very fine tooth pitch for cutting woodworking materials 1.5-15mm thick. Ideal for cutting hard materials such as laminate flooring. For use with jigsaws with T-Shank clamping systems. Fits all T-shank jigsaws.
